{{Top|leg}}
'''Star Tours Flight 625''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] just before a [[raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. Stationed at Gate 1M, the flight arrived at the [[Spaceport THX1138|space station]] at 1450 hours, and was scheduled to depart for Ord Mantell at 1545.
